title: Ultracode, creation fixes and a new Default theme
summary: Fewer creation errors and clearer updates.
added: Ultracode (Beta) after Max: deeper planning, review and verification when selected.
improved: Shorter, simpler release and update descriptions.
More reliable model and UI creation.
Solar Dusk is now the Default theme; the separate option is removed.
Ultracode adds purple accents and glow while keeping your theme.
fixed: Saved previews insert and export without extra errors.
Editing saved builds no longer fails on extra blueprint fields.
Failed updates show the actual error and log location.
notes: Platform checks passed. Live AI chats remain untested; no performance gain is claimed.
